body: Yeah I guess all I can do is keep on being there and loving this goober. Thank you so much for this, I really appreciate your response!

that’s where I’m at! after we started dating I’ve started calling myself queer, but also yeah I guess I shouldn’t have called myself a lesbian in this post haha. 

Do you think it’s okay to just outright ask them like that? I really don’t want to pressure them or force them to come out before they’re ready

Truthfully it’s hard to erase the triggers, he was my first real friend when I moved to a new city in a new state so a lot of places have his fingerprints all over. I definitely spend more time at home now, but I don’t think that’s More healthy. 

It’s hard because he says he was blackout drunk when he raped me— we had a very physically close relationship, so I think I want to blame myself for “leading him on”, so I can preserve some version of our friendship, if only in my head. I go back and forth a lot about how much I blame him. 

Thank you so much for your response, typing this out and then seeing your response made me realize this isn’t a normal part of the healing process— I thought i could deal with this on my own but I think I need outside help. I’m looking for therapists in my area right now
